market_summary: Nifty closed at 25,299 on 12 Nov, up 0.2% and at a six-month high; realty and banks led while IT lagged. Foreign investors bought ₹7,831 cr and domestic funds sold ₹6,331 cr that day. India VIX fell 5.3% to 16.6, so swings should be calmer; note Citi now expects two RBI rate hikes (Dec and Feb).

buy_ideas.name: Minda Corporation
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 43% and profit up 69% year on year. Revenue beat estimates by 10.7%. Growth from EV parts and digital displays. About 26% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Auto demand could slow. Mid-cap, so it swings more.

buy_ideas.name: Hindalco Industries
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 profit up 59% to ₹7,533 cr and EBITDA up 42% to ₹13,757 cr. Copper had its best-ever quarter and Novelis recovered. Nuvama raised FY27-28 EBITDA estimates 4-5%; 26% of FY28 aluminium already hedged at $3,168/t.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is the 6 Nov close and may have moved. Management says India aluminium costs rise about 5% in Q3. Tied to global metal prices.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 21% and profit up 32%, both above estimates. About 21% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Valuation is already high, and new hospitals take time to fill.

buy_ideas.name: State Bank of India
buy_ideas.thesis: Two brokers reiterated buys after results. Management guides 14-15% loan growth. CLSA target is about 25% above the ₹1,061 price.
buy_ideas.risks: Loan growth guidance trails system credit growth (18-19%). Rate hikes would squeeze some segments. Goldman's target gives only about 6% upside.

buy_ideas.name: Va Tech Wabag
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 22% and profit up 23%; record ₹20,207 cr order book.
buy_ideas.risks: Project delays and late customer payments.

avoid.reason: Results missed: Q2 EBITDA fell 45% and came in 30% below street estimates. UBS still says Buy at ₹840, but wait for execution to recover.

Reported profit up 64%, but adjusted for a ₹73.5 cr one-time gain it is up 28%. Brokers raised targets, but don't chase the spike.

portfolio_notes.BHARTIARTL: Dropped from buy ideas: profit up 31% but it slightly missed estimates. ICICI Direct still targets ₹2,400. Fine to hold with a stop.
portfolio_notes.FLUOROCHEM: Dropped from today's list only for space. Revenue up 45% and profit up 36%; ICICI Securities target ₹5,380 still stands.
portfolio_notes.KALYANKJIL: Citi raised its target to ₹880 and BoB Capital upgraded to Buy at ₹786, but adjusted profit growth is only 28%. Hold if owned; don't add on momentum.
portfolio_notes.LEMONTREE: Removed from avoid: CLSA rates it Outperform with a ₹163 target after a record quarter.
portfolio_notes.RVNL: Reports results today (13 Nov). Check the numbers before trading.
